chapter.verse: Tua bang ahih leh, vantunggam tawh kipawl hong sapna thupha a ngah misiangtho ute naute aw, a thuman Sawltak leh Siampi Ukpa ahi ci-a i san’ Zeisu tel takin enin ngaihsun un.
Moses in Pasian’ innpi sung khempeuh ah a diktat mah bangin Zeisu in amah a koihpa mai-ah a diktat hi.
Inn lampa in inn sangin minthan’na a neih zawk mah bangin Zeisu in Moses sangin a lianzaw minthan’na ngah dingin a kilawm hi ci-in eite in i ciamteh hi.
Inn khempeuh mi khat peuhmah in a lam hi. Na khempeuh a piangsakpa in Pasian ahi hi.
Moses in a nung ciangin a kigen ding nate-ah teci pang dingin nasem hi a, innpi sung khempeuh ah a diktat hi.
Khazih ahih leh, Tapa ahihna tawh innpi uk a, a diktat hi. Eite in lau lohna ahi zongin, lametna tawh kipawl lungdam kisaktheihna ahi zongin, a tawp mateng i let kip leh, tua innpi i hi hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Kha Siangtho in a gen mah bangin “Tuni-in ama aw na zak uh leh, na lungsim uh na khuahsak kei un. Keimah hong dong hong ze-etin, Keima hih theih nate, kum sawmli tawntung mu-in, gampa lakah kei tawh kilem lohna bawlin, hong hehsak huna a om bangin om kei un.
Tua ahih ciangin hih khangmite Ka deih kei a, ‘Amaute lungsim sung uhah a khial tawntung uh hi; Keima hih ngeinate a thei kei uh hi,’ ka ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute in Keima nopsakna sungah a tum thei ngei kei ding uh hi, ci-in hehin ka kiciam hi,” ci-in a gen mah bangin,
ute naute aw, note lakah khatpeuh peuh in mawh nopna uplahna lungsim tawh a nungta Pasian kiang pan na kinkhiat loh nadingun na kikeem un.
Mawh kheemna hangin note lakah a lung khauh mi a om khak loh nadingin, “Tu ni,” a kicih lai takin nisimin khat leh khat kihansuah un.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, eite in i kipat cil upna bangin a tawp dongin i kip leh, Khazih tawh a ngah khawmte i hi ding hi.
Lai Siangtho sungah a gen mah bangin: “Tuni-in note in ama aw na zak uh leh, kilemlohna bawlin hehsakna hunah na om ngei bangun, na lungsim uh na khauhsak kei un.”
Thu za napi-un kilemlohna bawlin a hehsak mite kua ahi hiam? Moses nungzui-in Izipt gam pan a paikhia uh mi khempeuhte in tua bang hilo ahi uh hiam?
Kum sawmli tawntung a deih lo mite in kuate ahi uh hiam? Mawhna khialhna bawlin gam lakah pukin a si mite hilo ahi uh hiam?
“Note in keima nopsakna sungah na tum kei ding uh hi,” ci-in ciamsiatna a thuak mite, a thungai lote sim loh, kua mite ahi uh hiam?
Tua ahih ciangin amau in a up loh manunah a tum zawh loh uh i thei hi.
